blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Monocular head pose estimation is usually formulated as absolute regression from a single face crop, yet many applications observe the same person over time and can supply an explicit anchor image. Recently, relative head pose estimation was proposed, which casts the problem as estimation of the relative geometric change between an anchor and a query image. However, existing methods still require the anchor image pose to be known at inference, significantly limiting their practical use. We first extend relative head pose estimation to full 6DoF by additionally predicting a depth-normalized relative translation, which composes with the anchor to recover metric query pose in the camera frame. To eliminate the need for a ground-truth anchor pose, we reconstruct a personalized avatar from a single unlabeled enrollment image and render a bank of virtual anchors with known poses. The bank provides robust rotation hypotheses through multi-anchor consensus, while the real enrollment image serves as the real anchor in the translation branch via landmark PnP. We also introduce an efficient variant that amortizes the bank cost once at enrollment, after which each query requires a single real-to-real relative prediction, with limited accuracy sacrifice. The relative pose estimator is trained exclusively on synthetic face renderings, without real pose supervision, pseudo-labels, domain adaptation, or fine-tuning on the evaluation sets. On real 6DoF benchmarks, ReVA-HPE achieves state-of-the-art rotation accuracy on BIWI and, given a near-frontal enrollment image, on FaMoS, while remaining competitive in metric translation despite relying solely on synthetic pose supervision. Project page and code: https://vasilikivas.github.io/ReVA-HPE/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Head pose provides a compact geometric cue to a person’s attention and interaction with the surroundings. Reliable estimation of this cue supports applications including gaze analysis, driver monitoring, facial understanding, telepresence, sign-language systems, and human-robot interaction [ 23 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 头部姿势为人们的注意和与周围环境的互动提供了紧凑的几何提示. 对这一线索的可靠估计支持各种应用,包括视距分析、驱动器监测、面部理解、远程存在、手语系统以及人-机器人互动[23,1]。

blocks.en: Most learned head pose estimators focus on orientation, predicting yaw, pitch, and roll- or an equivalent rotation representation-directly from a single face crop [ 25 , 37 , 13 , 34 ] . A smaller body of work targets full 6DoF pose, additionally recovering the metric translation of the head with respect to the camera [ 2 , 15 , 5 ] . This setting is considerably more challenging: rotation must remain robust to extreme poses and appearance variation, while translation also depends on camera intrinsics, crop geometry, subject scale, and the precise definition of the anatomical head origin.
blocks.zh: 大多数有学识的头像都以取向为主线,从单一面部收成直接预测出yaw, pitch,以及卷起或等同的旋转代表[25,37,13,34]. 规模较小的工作目标为完全6DOF外形,另外恢复相机头部的度量翻译[2,15,5]. 这种设定具有更大的挑战性:自转必须保持坚固到极端姿势和外观变化,而翻译也取决于相机内在,收成几何,主题尺度,以及解剖头部的精确定义.

blocks.en: Recently, VGGT-HPE [ 27 ] reformulated head pose estimation as relative pose prediction: given an anchor and a query image, the model estimates their relative geometric transformation and composes it with the anchor pose to recover the query pose. This image-matching formulation enabled VGGT-HPE to outperform leading absolute-regression methods on real-face benchmarks, including methods using real or mixed pose supervision, despite relying solely on synthetic pose supervision.
blocks.zh: 最近,VGGT-HPE [27] 重制后头作为相对姿势预测提出估计:由于一个锚和一个查询图像,模型估计它们相对几何变换,并用锚地姿势来作曲以恢复查询姿势. 这种图像匹配配方使得VGGT-HPE在真实面基准上超越了领先的绝对回归方法,包括使用真实或混合外观监督的方法,尽管完全依赖于合成外观监督.

blocks.en: In this paper, we turn relative head pose estimation into a complete 6DoF system that does not require a ground-truth anchor pose, called Relative Virtual-Anchor Head Pose Estimation (ReVA-HPE) and summarized in Figure 1 . We first extend the previous rotation-centered formulation to predict both relative rotation and relative translation, allowing the query head pose to be recovered metrically in the camera frame. We then remove the known-anchor-pose assumption by constructing, from a single unlabeled enrollment image, a personalized virtual-anchor bank with known poses. We estimate the query rotation by robustly combining predictions from the virtual anchors in the bank. Metric translation is obtained separately through a single PnP solve on the enrollment image. We also introduce an efficient variant that processes the virtual-anchor bank only once, during enrollment. After this one-time calibration, each new query requires a single network inference, with only a small loss in accuracy. The relative pose estimator is trained exclusively on procedural face renderings, without real pose supervision, pseudo-labels, or target-domain fine-tuning. Despite this restricted supervision, ReVA-HPE achieves state-of-the-art rotation accuracy on BIWI and, given a near-frontal enrollment image, on FaMoS, while remaining competitive in metric translation. blocks.en: 2.1 Monocular Head Pose and 6DoF Face Pose
blocks.zh: 2.1 单发头花和6DoF 脸庞

blocks.en: Early head-pose systems relied on facial correspondences, 3D templates, and perspective pose solvers. Modern approaches predominantly learn an absolute mapping from a face crop to Euler angles or a rotation representation. HopeNet combines classification and regression [ 25 ] , FSA-Net aggregates fine-grained facial structure [ 33 ] , WHENet targets wide-range orientation [ 37 ] , 6DRepNet uses a continuous 6D rotation representation with geodesic supervision [ 13 ] , and TokenHPE learns transformer orientation tokens [ 34 ] . These methods are effective for orientation but learn a dataset-specific absolute reference from training images.
blocks.zh: 早期的头像系统依赖于面部对应,3D模板,以及视角摆出解相. 现代方法主要学习从面稼到欧勒角或自转代表的绝对映射. HopeNet将分类和回归结合起来[25],FSA-Net汇总精细的面部结构[33],WEMet目标为广域取向[37],6D RepNet 使用连续的6D自转表示并进行大地测量监督[13],Token HPE学习变压器定向符号 [34]. 这些方法对定向有效,但从培训图像中学习到数据集特有的绝对参考。

blocks.en: Fewer methods evaluate complete 6DoF head pose. img2pose directly predicts face pose and detection [ 2 ] , PerspNet reconstructs facial geometry under perspective projection and recovers 6DoF pose [ 15 ] , and TRG explicitly couples head translation, rotation, and facial geometry [ 5 ] . Landmark PnP remains a strong geometric baseline when calibrated intrinsics and reliable 2D-3D correspondences are available [ 17 , 9 ] . Our method differs in predicting both rotation and translation relative to a visible anchor , then using virtual anchors to remove the need for a GT pose.

blocks.en: 2.2 Relative Pose & Geometry Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 相对Pose和几何基础模型

blocks.en: Relative transformations are standard in visual odometry, SLAM, tracking, and reference-based object pose estimation because correspondences across observations constrain displacement directly [ 26 , 30 ] . Recent geometry foundation models generalize this idea across broad image domains. CroCo learns cross-view completion [ 32 ] , DUSt3R predicts point maps without known calibration [ 29 ] , MASt3R grounds feature matching in 3D [ 18 ] , and VGGT jointly predicts cameras and dense scene geometry from one or more images [ 28 ] . VGGT-HPE [ 27 ] adapts VGGT’s camera branch to paired head images with LoRA. In this work we keep the relative image-pair formulation, extend it to explicit relative translation, and address the test-time anchor problem by constructing RGB-derived anchor sources from a single enrollment image.
blocks.zh: 相对变相在视觉的odometry,SLAM,跟踪,和基于参考的物体中是标准的,因为跨观测的对应直接约束了迁移[26,30]. 最近的几何基础模型将这一想法概括到广泛的图像域. CroCo学习了交叉取景完成 [32],DUST3R在没有已知校正[29]的情况下预测出点地图,MASt3R地表特征相匹配于3D [18],而VGGT联合从一个或多个图像中预测相机和密集场景几何[28]. VGGT-HPE [27] 调整了VGGT相机分机,将头像与LORA配对. 在这部作品中,我们保留了相对的图像-pair配方,将其扩展至清晰的相对翻译,并通过从单一的录入图像构建出RGB出自主锚源来解决测试时间锚地问题.

blocks.en: 2.3 Synthetic Pose Supervision
blocks.zh: 2.3 合成松脂监督

blocks.en:
Synthetic supervision in head pose estimation commonly relies on
pose-expanded real images. For example, 300W-LP [ 38 ] uses 3D face profiling to generate large-pose views from real photographs
and is widely used to train absolute estimators such as
6DRepNet [ 13 ] and
TokenHPE [ 34 ] . Procedural face models provide a
different form of supervision: FLAME [ 20 ] allows direct
control over identity, expression, viewpoint, and pose without deriving
training examples from real images. VGGT-HPE [ 27 ] showed that relative rotation learned from such procedural renderings
transfers effectively to real faces. We build on this setting, extending
the relative target to full 6DoF while removing the need for a known anchor
pose. The task-specific adaptation of our relative estimator uses no real
head-pose images, pose annotations, pseudo-labels, or target-domain
fine-tuning.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We build on VGGT-HPE [ 27 ] , which estimates head pose by predicting the geometric change between an anchor and a query image. Two components are missing for a practical 6DoF system. First, the original relative prediction covers only rotation. We add an explicit depth-normalized translation target, allowing us to recover metric camera-frame translation once the translation of the anchor is known. Second, VGGT-HPE requires the ground-truth pose of the anchor image at test time. We remove this requirement by replacing the labeled anchor with a single unlabeled enrollment image. From this image, we construct a personalized bank of virtual anchors for rotation and use landmark-based PnP to obtain the metric translation of the enrollment anchor. The full pipeline is illustrated in Figure 2 .

blocks.en: VGGT-HPE [ 27 ] reframes head pose estimation as relative prediction. Instead of regressing an absolute pose from a single crop, it receives an anchor image and a query image and predicts the geometric change between them, which is then composed with the anchor image ground-truth pose. We keep the pairwise VGGT-HPE architecture and relative-rotation composition, and extend its camera target with explicit depth-normalized translation.

blocks.en: Datasets and Protocols. The BIWI Kinect Head Pose Database [ 8 ] contains 24 calibrated RGB-D recordings of 20 individuals with frame-level 6DoF head poses. We treat each recording as a separate subject. For every subject, the first available RGB frame is fixed as enrollment before any score is computed and removed from the query set, leaving 15,654 queries. We additionally evaluate on the FaMoS [ 3 ] test set to assess transfer beyond BIWI. We use only camera index 0 throughout the evaluation. Frame-level 6DoF labels are obtained from the provided ground-truth registrations: for each subject, we rigidly align its identity-specific FLAME-topology template to each registered frame using Procrustes analysis, and use the resulting transformation as the head pose in the dataset camera frame. We follow the same protocol as BIWI, using the first available frame for enrollment and the remaining frames as queries.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和讨论

blocks.en: Our results lead to three main observations. First, synthetic pose supervision transfers well in the relative formulation: ReVA-HPE shows substantially less cross-dataset degradation than the matched synthetic absolute baseline. Domain shift nevertheless remains, as performance still depends on the dataset, anchor geometry, avatar quality, and camera calibration. Second, the virtual-anchor bank remains effective even though no rendered view perfectly matches the query. Consensus across virtual anchors suppresses inconsistent hypotheses and improves rotation accuracy. Third, increasing the bank size helps up to M = 20 M{=}20 , after which performance plateaus or declines as additional virtual anchors extend farther from the frontal pose range.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果导致三个主要意见。 首先,合成在相对配方中构成良好的监督转移: ReVA-HPE显示的跨数据集降解比相匹配的合成绝对基线要少得多. 然而,域位变化仍然存在,因为性能仍然取决于数据集、锚地几何、相机质量和相机校正。 第二,虚拟锁定库依然有效,尽管没有提供与查询完全匹配的视图。 跨虚拟锚地的共识压制了不一致的假设,并改进了旋转的准确性. 第三,增加银行规模有助于达到M = 20 M = 20,此后,随着额外的虚拟锚地从前置位置范围更远地延伸,性能高地或下降。

blocks.en: Metric translation still depends on PnP applied to the real anchor image. This provides a simple and effective metric reference, but makes translation sensitive to landmark quality and enrollment pose. Extreme orientations can degrade landmark localization and the resulting PnP estimate. The real anchor should therefore preferably have a near-neutral pose, although moderate off-axis poses are well tolerated.
blocks.zh: Metric 翻译仍然依赖于应用到真实主播图像的PnP. 这提供了一个简单而有效的参考标准,但使翻译对具有里程碑意义的质量和入学率具有敏感性。 极端取向可降解地标本地化和由此产生的PnP估计. 因此,真正的锚应该有一个接近中性的姿势,尽管温和的离轴姿势是完全容忍的。

blocks.en: The main remaining limitation is the dependence on avatar and calibration quality. Errors in identity, hair, silhouette, or unseen profile geometry can weaken anchor consensus. Moreover, avatar reconstruction, landmark-based calibration, and relative pose estimation are separate stages and are not jointly optimized. Future work could optimize the avatar directly for geometric matching and exploit temporal continuity in video, since the current method treats each query independently.
blocks.zh: 剩下的主要限制是依赖外形和校正质量. 身份,发型, silhouette, 或隐形剖面几何学的错误会削弱锚地共识. 此外,模拟重建、基于地标的校准和相对姿势估计是不同的阶段,没有共同优化。 未来的工作可以直接为几何匹配而优化外观并利用视频中的时间连续性,因为目前的方法独立处理每个查询.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented ReVA-HPE, which extends relative head pose estimation to complete metric 6DoF without requiring a ground-truth anchor pose at inference. The pose estimator uses only 25,000 procedural FLAME renderings, without real-image pose supervision, pseudo-labels, or target-domain fine-tuning. At inference, a personalized virtual-anchor bank provides robust rotation hypotheses through multi-anchor consensus, while a single PnP solve on the enrollment image grounds metric translation. On BIWI, ReVA-HPE achieves 2.53 ∘ 2.53^{\circ} rotation MAE and outperforms all baselines reproduced under the same protocol, including methods using real or mixed pose supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了ReVA-HPE,它把相对头部的估算扩展至完成度量6DoF,而不需要地面真能主播的推论。 姿势估测器仅使用25,000个程序FLAME渲染,没有真相外观监督,伪标签,或目标域微调. 推论,一个个性化的虚拟-锁定银行通过多锁定共识提供坚固的旋转假说,而一个单一的PnP在入场图像基数的度量翻译上解析. 在BIWI上,ReVA-HPE实现2.53 ∘ 2.53 ^{\ Circ}旋转MAE并超越了同一协议所复制的所有基线,包括使用真实或混合形而上学监督的方法.
